peer_table_not_found.derivation: the positive page:1 without its 'Peer  Period end  ...' header line; used only by refusal r11 (no run)

synthetic_source.why: No frozen source carries a second issuer. The source adds an invented peer summary so the median, outlier and position rules have something to compute.
consistency_with_frozen_figures: The issuer line restates frozen FY2025 figures exactly: revenue 120.0 (page:2), adjusted EBITDA 30.0 (page:2), total debt 50.0 (page:4, 50.00), interest expense 5.0 (page:3 cash interest paid 5.00, the peer sheet's own definition; CP-1 coverage uses page:2 net interest expense, also 5.00, so the two are equal here), FFO 21.0 (page:3 operating cash flow before working capital 21.00); each asserted equal by the builder
The issuer's basis line (IFRS, 1 operating segment, December 31 year end) equals frozen page:1 'Reporting basis: IFRS', 'One operating segment' and identity 'Fiscal year end: December 31'
The issuer ratios recomputed from the issuer line equal CP-1's T4.10 LTM values exactly: 25.0%, 5/3 (1.67x), 6.00x, 42.0% (asserted)
The source adds no fact about the issuer's business, ownership, debt terms or any frozen quantity beyond the five restated figures
Peer names carry no digit (the claim check treats a digit outside a label or the issuer name as a bare figure)

positive.execution: closed run: CP-0, CP-1 (five stages, readiness = cp1_readiness literal, source_context literal with the peers source), CP-1C

gap.execution: closed run: interest coverage has two peers with a value, below the minimum of three, so its median, position, outlier count and flags are missing; the other three metrics have three

no_peers.pack: identity + financial, as tests/test_financial_workflow.py make_pack() (no peer source)
no_peers.execution: closed run: the limitation-only design: issuer cells known (CP-1), every peer-derived cell missing, never 0

cp1_fact_selection_rule.predicate: fact.table_id == 'T4.10' and fact.period == period and fact.label == '<column> · <metric>' with column 'LTM Q4 25 (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31)'; exactly one match, zero or several fail closed
cp1_fact_selection_rule.copy_rule: T1C.3.issuer.<metric> and T1C.6.<metric>.cp1 copy the CP-1 fact: same unit, amount, decimals/currency/scale, value_class and citations; calculation_id is CP-1's own, bound at run time ({{CP1_CALCULATION_ID}}); the module fact id is its own
cp1_fact_selection_rule.probe: S1 positive promoted CP-1 head, read-only copy, 2026-10-28: adjusted_ebitda_margin PERCENT 0.25 calculated (25.0%); total_leverage_adjusted MULTIPLE 1.6666666666666666666666666666666666667 calculated (1.67x); interest_coverage_adjusted MULTIPLE 6 calculated (6.00x); ffo_to_debt PERCENT 0.42 calculated (42.0%); all known; no currency/scale on ratios

plan.cp_model: not requested. registry.plan(('CP-1C','CP-MODEL')) = (CP-0, CP-1, CP-1C, CP-MODEL): CP-MODEL would follow CP-1C
